THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Loaded Steak & Egg Skillet

Same meal. Different plates. Everyone wins.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME10 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~300 cal | ~40g protein

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 3 large eggs
  • 3 oz Soules Kitchen Thinly Sliced Beef Fajitas
  • 1 oz Kraft Fat Free Cheddar Cheese

Ingredients — continued

  • Dan-O's Crunchy Seasoning
  • Redmond Real Salt
  • Fresh red + green chilies (optional — adults only)

You want ~40g protein in 10 minutes flat — one pan, no complexity, splits perfectly for kids.

Method

  1. 1.PREP. Chop Soules fajita beef into smaller pieces if needed. Slice chilies. Whisk eggs with a pinch of Redmond Real Salt.
  2. 2.HEAT + BUILD. Medium heat pan. Add steak + chilies. Season with Dan-O's Crunchy. Cook 1–2 min — it's already cooked, just reheat + slight crisp.
  3. 3.ADD EGGS. Pour eggs evenly over steak. Do not stir. Cover the pan — this is key.
  4. 4.ADD CHEESE. Sprinkle 1 oz Kraft fat-free cheddar evenly. Light hit of Dan-O's Crunchy on top.
  5. 5.FINISH. Cover 1–2 min until eggs are set. Fold or leave open-face.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid: Serve the kid portion as described above.

If something fails

Eggs are rubbery: Heat was too high or you cooked too long after covering. Medium heat, 1-2 min covered max.

Steak is chewy: Chop it smaller. It's pre-cooked — you just need to warm and crisp the edges.

Feels too lean / light: Add a slice of avocado or a drizzle of olive oil on top. Don't change the base recipe.

Cheese didn't melt: You didn't cover the pan. The steam melts the cheese — lid is non-negotiable.

Storage and reheating

Store: Best made fresh — 10 min is fast enough. Don't batch this.

Reheat: N/A — each one is made fresh in 10 min.

Lasts: N/A — cook per serving.
